title: Integrated experimental and computational study reveals enhanced antimicrobial efficacy of amoxicillin loaded in oleic acid nanoemulsion against multidrug-resistant Salmonella typhimurium
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,34237-34256
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05196G, Paper
Open Access

Seifeldin Elabed, Amira K. Mohamed, Hassan Youssef, Huda Abdelhamied, Eyad Mokhtar, Wael M. Elshemey, Medhat W. Shafaa, Ayman Meselhi
Oleic acid nanoemulsion undergoes pH-dependent self-assembly in acidic infection sites, disrupting bacterial membranes and enhancing amoxicillin uptake. This lowers MIC, accelerates bacterial killing, and inhibits biofilm formation. Boosting β-lactam efficacy against Salmonella typhimurium.
